title: A review boundary you can inspect.
description: An internal example from this ElevateX website: selecting Review the draft exposes the proposed response and the point where a person decides what may happen next.
method: Open the local AI Automation service page with the recorded viewport and reduced motion.
Use keyboard focus and Space to select Review the draft; record the checked native control and its visible explanation.
Inspect the radio markup, CSS selection rule and the existing manual-selection guard in the fingerprinted source files.

observations.title: Native selection
observations.text: A standard radio control selects this explanation. The checked control and its visible detail were recorded together.

observations.title: A draft stays a draft
observations.text: The interface exposes the proposed reply and approve, edit or decline instructions. Selecting it sends no message and writes no customer record.

observations.title: Manual control
observations.text: The existing enhancement stops optional scroll progression when focus or a user selection takes control. The native interface remains available without that enhancement.

limitations: This is a local interface observation and source inspection, not a live automation deployment, a performance benchmark or a client result.
Backend delivery and external integrations are not exercised.

excerpt.code:

              class="inquiry-step__radio"

              id={`inquiry-${step.id}`}
              value={step.id}
              aria-describedby={`inquiry-${step.id}-description`}
              checked={index === 0}
            />
